selection: Deduplicate exact article URLs within each market, retaining sorted tickers. Identify candidate financial statements by numeric tokens and financial-metric vocabulary in the published title/summary. Human screen and paraphrase candidates before gold construction; reject keyword false positives without replacing them based on gold or model output. Seeded SHA-256 ordering, round-robin across (market, outlet, ticker) strata. Financial candidates first, then non-financial items, disjoint URLs. If the snapshot has fewer eligible financial items, retain the entire eligible population and disclose the shortfall; never fabricate, perturb, supplement from other dates, or treat multiple statements as independent stories to meet the target.
paraphrase: One short factual statement per sampled story, preserving the story's stated numbers, qualification, company and period. Never infer a missing period from publication date, add a fiscal qualifier, correct a number using gold, or retain third-party headlines/summaries. Store outlet, URL, publication date, ticker, story hash and selection metadata. Raw published payloads stay in an ignored .cache directory only.
gold: Independent program extraction from primary SEC raw facts and issuer release passages; no agent calls or claimcheck numeric-verdict code. Record exact source coordinates/hashes and arithmetic/rounding. Explicit unsupported-domain labels for price moves, opinions, Taiwan filings and other unavailable evidence; unresolved missing periods, metric definitions or conflicting sources go to a Claude review list, never guessed. Accuracy excludes unresolved review cases and reports their count and operational outcomes separately. Freeze and commit protocol, claims and gold before any paid model call.

execution.budget_scope: All agent and post calls, retries, failures and retained reservations in this task share one append-only ledger with provider-specific caps.
execution.application_retries: Current production retry policy, each call reserved in the shared ledger.
execution.post_path: One paraphrased story per python -m claimcheck post invocation, same providers and items. Publication metadata is not added as claim context.
execution.order: Seeded item order; provider workers independent and each serial, agent pass then post pass. Stop provider cleanly when reservation cap refuses a call; unattempted pairs retained as budget stops. No outcome-driven retries.

metrics: accuracy with Wilson 95% CI on resolved gold; failures count wrong
false-supported among gold contradicted/insufficient with Wilson CI
supported/contradicted/insufficient/skip/failure shares for all sampled items and by type
post extraction and checked-item coverage separately from verdict accuracy
ledger cost per claim attempt and per sampled item, failures included
source-outlet and claim-type breakdowns, small samples labelled
limits: Selected published feed snapshot, not random finance-news prevalence or a new held-out benchmark
Paraphrasing tests the verifier and text post path, not fidelity of the original feed summarizer or article full text
No invented false controls; false-supported estimates may have few negative gold items
TW outside the current US SEC evidence domain
